name: Point Diffusion Implicit Function (PDF)
definition: A Point Diffusion implicit Function (PDF) for large-scale scene neural representation that learns a dense surface distribution via a diffusion-based point prior generative model to reduce the sampling space from unbounded 3D space to the 2D scene surface.
summary: Point Diffusion Implicit Function is a neural representation for novel view synthesis that reduces 3D sampling to a 2D surface using a diffusion-based point cloud prior.
